method: 84,899 retained steps of pseudo-random inverse iteration with a fixed seed after 101 discarded steps; z <- plus/minus sqrt(z-1), starting from repelling fixed point (1+i sqrt(3))/2. Pixel marks enhance visibility of the Cantor Julia set.
